label: Filesystems
description: Manages named Filesystem definitions and opens Filesystem instances from definitions or provider URLs.

editors.description: Configured file editors keyed by stable editor ID.

listProviders.description: Lists configured providers with cloned schemas and defaults suitable for management UI.

returns.description: Promise resolving to provider metadata sorted by provider ID.

listDefinitions.description: Lists persisted non-secret named Filesystem definitions sorted by name.

returns.description: Promise resolving to defensive copies of the named definitions.

getDefinition.description: Gets one named Filesystem definition and its optional provider credentials for management editing.

returns.description: Promise resolving to a defensive definition with optional credentials, or null when the definition is missing.

saveDefinition.description: Validates and saves one named Filesystem definition and optionally replaces or removes its provider credentials.

parameters.name: definition
parameters.description: Definition containing name, label, provider, and non-secret provider options.

parameters.name: credentials
parameters.description: Optional provider credentials. Omission preserves existing credentials, an object replaces them, and null removes them.

returns.description: Promise resolving after the definition has been saved.

removeDefinition.description: Removes one named Filesystem definition and invalidates its named runtime cache entry.

returns.description: Promise resolving after the definition has been removed.

openNamed.description: Opens a persisted named Filesystem using its validated provider options and name-based runtime cache identity.

returns.description: Promise resolving to an instance implementing the Filesystem contract.

open.description: Opens the Filesystem represented by a configured provider URL. Repeated calls share an instance only when the provider supplies a raw-URL cache identity.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Filesystem URL, such as mem:, opfs:, file:, or https://example.com/files.

returns.description: Promise resolving to an instance implementing the Filesystem contract.

getEditor.description: Returns the configured editor matching a file path, or null when no editor supports its extension.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Filesystem path to match, including the file name.

returns.description: A defensive copy of the matching editor descriptor, or null.
